ammonia.reason: Limited deamination without surface flora at 90 d; moderate proteolysis only.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol/indole from pasture tryptophan/tyrosine catabolism and raw-milk enterococci.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic peptides from chymosin/plasmin on ovine casein accentuated by 4.2% salt.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium; methyl ketones 2-heptanone/2-nonanone reported at lower intensity.

browning.reason: Maillard from free amino acids/peptides with trace residual lactose on heating.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by lactococci/leuconostoc; among highest in Canestrato.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric/caproic/capric acids dominant in ~1670 mg/kg total FFA via rennet and raw-milk lipases.

creaminess.reason: Low moisture 35.4% and high protein 29.5% with high salt limit fat lubrication.

crumbliness.reason: Demineralized paracasein at pH 5.1 with 90-d proteolysis gives short granular fracture.

firmness.reason: Progressive drying to 35.4% moisture with dry-salting and pressed basket-molded paste.

floral_honey.reason: Low phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine catabolism, masked by FFA.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate/octanoate main but relatively low esters from esterase esterification.

goaty.reason: Sheep-milk branched C8-C10 acids 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic plus hexanoic/octanoic lipolysis.

malty_nutty.reason: Strecker aldehydes 3-methylbutanal/2-methylpropanal from Leu/Val/Ile catabolism during ripening.

melt.reason: pH 5.1 with 4.2% NaCl and low moisture restricts casein hydration and flow.

mushroom_earthy.reason: Trace 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleate oxidation; no mold to amplify.

oil_off.reason: Free fat from 25.7% sheep fat and lipolyzed triglycerides coalesces on heating.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenols; dry-salted rind only.

sour_vinegar.reason: Lactic acid to pH 5.1 plus low acetic acid from NSLAB; lower acetic than Romano/Fiore.

stretch.reason: Non-pasta-filata rennet curd with no hot-water stretching; no aligned casein fibers.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Low methionine-derived methanethiol/DMS; uncooked curd with no thermophilic sulfur burst.

sweet.reason: Lactose depleted by day 3; faint sweetness only from amino acids and glycerol.

umami.reason: Glutamate accumulation from plasmin/chymosin and Lactobacillus proteolysis enhanced by salt.
